items.title: Google adds a desktop homepage sidebar for recent AI Mode chats
items.summary: 《The Verge》報道，Google正在更新桌面版首頁，用家可以打開可收合側欄查看同繼續AI Mode對話，並可開新對話、搜尋舊對話或連接Gemini Notebook。Google產品副總裁Robby Stein在X表示，測試中呢個側欄有助用家繼續探索；新首頁正全球向桌面用戶推出。
items.imageAlt: The Verge article image for Google's homepage AI chats update

items.title: Google launches Tool Retrieval in preview in the Gemini Interactions API
items.summary: Google喺Gemini Interactions API以預覽形式推出Tool Retrieval，讓代理唔使每次都把完整工具參數結構放入提示，只喺當前任務需要時先載入，以減少輸入token並維持工具選擇準確度。功能適用於Gemini 3.6及之後型號（包括所有Gemini 4型號），不另行收費，輸入同輸出按所用模型嘅標準價格計算。
items.note: publishedAt converted from the official page meta published_time 2026-11-19T18:00:00+00:00.
items.imageAlt: Official hero image from Google's Gemini API Tool Retrieval announcement

items.title: Google adds computer use to the Gemini app for Mac, letting it operate desktop apps and the web
items.summary: Google喺Gemini Mac版應用推出computer use功能，用家可以用文字描述多步任務，由Gemini喺獨立背景視窗操作本機檔案、桌面應用同網站，並可預覽、選擇應用權限同審批敏感動作。官方註明需使用搭載Apple Silicon、運行macOS Sequoia 15.0或以上嘅Mac，面向18歲或以上個人Google帳戶嘅AI Plus、Pro同Ultra用戶；9to5Google報道指功能即日起先以美國英語推出。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. 9to5Google reported the US English rollout at 10:55 a.m. PT on Nov 19 (2026-11-20T02:55:00+08:00).
items.imageAlt: Official header image from Google's Gemini computer use for Mac announcement

items.title: Google makes Genie 4 available to developers through the Gemini API
items.summary: 繼前一日向Gemini AI Ultra用戶開放Project Genie之後，Google宣布Genie 4已可經Gemini API（Interactions API）同Google AI Studio供開發者使用。開發者可以用文字提示或參考圖片生成720p、每秒24格並附同步原聲音訊嘅可互動世界，再用即時鍵盤同即時文字提示操控場景；輸出會加入SynthID浮水印。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. This is a new developer-API follow-up to yesterday's Project Genie consumer launch.
items.imageAlt: Official social share image from Google's Genie 4 Gemini API announcement

items.title: OpenAI starts rolling out a new ChatGPT mobile app experience, starting with Pro users
items.summary: OpenAI開始為ChatGPT流動應用推出新介面，將dot獨立成一個分頁，並可把Codex、Projects同Images等功能釘喺分頁列。官方稱先向已提供dots地區、18歲或以上嘅ChatGPT Pro用戶推出，不包括歐洲經濟區（包括歐盟）、英國、瑞士同韓國；部分合資格Plus用戶亦會見到，部分Pro用戶會預設用新設計，亦可在設定開關。
items.note: Official ChatGPT release notes list this under November 19, 2026, with no exact time, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.

items.title: ChatGPT Health starts rolling out to Android, the desktop app, dots and sites
items.summary: OpenAI稱由11月19日起，ChatGPT Health會推廣至更多使用場景，包括桌面應用、dots、sites同Android，並支援Health Connect，方便連接健康同健身資料。
items.note: Official ChatGPT release notes list this under November 19, 2026, with no exact time, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. This item sticks to the confirmed rollout surfaces and Health Connect support.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out Live Dictation in ChatGPT and removes the 10-minute recording limit
items.summary: OpenAI喺ChatGPT推出Live Dictation，語音會喺講嘅同時轉成文字，用家可以點擊波形顯示或隱藏即時逐字稿，並取消咗10分鐘錄音上限。官方稱功能正全球向所有ChatGPT方案，喺iOS、Android、網頁同桌面應用推出。
items.note: Official ChatGPT release notes list this under November 18, 2026, with no exact time, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. The Verge covered the same rollout on Nov 19, 3:16 p.m. UTC.

items.title: Microsoft makes Aion Instruct generally available as an open-weights model and as Edge's built-in on-device model
items.summary: Microsoft宣布Aion Instruct以開源權重在Hugging Face一般可用，並成為Microsoft Edge內建嘅端側小語言模型，取代Phi-4-mini。官方稱模型有23億參數，較Phi更細更快，適用於網頁常見嘅生成、摘要、跟隨指示同結構化輸出；同時開放Prompt API來源試驗（origin trial），並推出實驗性Decisions API開發者預覽。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. The page og:image is a generic Edge social image from 2021, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Cloudflare open-sources updated Clairic and 9B Clairic-flash extraction models
items.summary: Cloudflare宣布更新版Clairic，以及90億參數、較輕較快嘅Clairic-flash，以開源權重形式發布，並托管於Workers AI，完整權重可在Hugging Face取得。公司稱新版加強從圖像同PDF等複雜文件提取資料，並改善表格、清單同日期處理。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. This was published on Nov 18 and was not in yesterday's batch.
items.imageAlt: Header image from Cloudflare's open-weight Clairic announcement

items.title: Samdei Labs releases Samdei Type Mini and Base, open models that convert romanized Khmer to Khmer script
items.summary: Samdei Labs在Hugging Face發布兩個開源模型Samdei Type Mini（710萬參數）同Base（1,820萬參數），用嚟把拉丁字母拼音柬埔寨文轉成高棉文，並一併公開訓練數據、2,155條日常訊息測試集同技術報告。官方稱在該測試集上，Base同Mini嘅字元錯誤率分別為0.052同0.058，低於現時最佳開源模型嘅0.066。
items.note: Source page lists the date only (November 18, 2026); exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. This was not in yesterday's batch.
items.imageAlt: Illustration from the Samdei Type Hugging Face blog post

items.title: AI-enabled Smart Water Tank Cleaning Robot wins Hong Kong ICT Awards 2026 Award of the Year
items.summary: 2026香港資訊及通訊科技獎頒獎典禮11月19日晚舉行，機電工程署、建築署、房屋署、香港智能建造研發中心同香港房屋協會憑「AI-enabled Smart Water Tank Cleaning Robot」（官方中文稿作「人工智慧清潔水箱機器人」）奪得商業方案獎大獎及全年大獎。財政司司長陳茂波出席頒獎，並提到政府正透過AI+相關委員會，為產業應用人工智能創造條件。
items.imageAlt: Financial Secretary Paul Chan speaking at the Hong Kong ICT Awards 2026 presentation ceremony on 19 November 2026

items.title: PSITI Kevin Choi outlines Hong Kong's open-source AI role at a UN workshop
items.summary: 創新科技及工業局常任秘書長蔡志惇11月19日在聯合國數碼及新興科技辦公室舉辦嘅開源人工智能研討會致開幕辭，指香港可作為內地與國際之間嘅橋樑，推動開源人工智能發展。佢表示香港整體算力已達5,000 PFLOPS（當中3,000來自數碼港人工智能超算中心），興建中嘅沙嶺數據設施群預計到2032年再提供18萬 PFLOPS，相當於現時算力嘅36倍；今年較早成立嘅香港人工智能研發院正籌備投入運作。
items.imageAlt: Innovation, Technology and Industry Permanent Secretary Kevin Choi speaking at the UN open-source AI workshop on 19 November 2026

items.title: The Verge: Meta's Muse Charm might cost $300, The Information reports
items.summary: 《The Verge》引述《The Information》報道，Meta計劃將即將推出、可讓用戶與Muse人工智能代理對話嘅Muse Charm定價為300美元，並附送Verizon 12個月免費5G數據計劃；行政總裁扎克伯格較早前曾表示預計可在12月假期檔期出貨，但當時未公布售價。Meta發言人未有確認有關定價，只表示對外界關注公司人工智能裝置感到高興，並會再作公布；報道亦指Meta智能手錶計劃已推遲至2027年。
items.note: Price, Verizon 5G plan and smartwatch delay are attributed to The Information and have not been confirmed by Meta.
items.imageAlt: A photo of the Muse Charm gadget, from The Verge's report

items.title: TechCrunch: Reuters says Meta employees reported Muse mixing up conversations and private data
items.summary: 《TechCrunch》引述路透報道，Meta員工喺內部帖文反映，人工智能代理Muse曾混淆不同帳戶對話，並顯示員工並未提出過嘅托兒請求、職業建議、產品訂單，以至不屬於自己嘅銀行結餘，亦有員工指Muse提到Signal上嘅私人訊息。Meta向《TechCrunch》表示員工測試係產品開發一部分，而且員工接觸嘅Muse版本往往與公開版本不同。
items.note: The underlying account is a Reuters report on internal employee posts. Meta says employees often test features not available to the public. Reuters coverage has also noted it could not always determine whether surfaced data was real or hallucinated.
items.imageAlt: Image of Meta's Muse AI agent from TechCrunch's report

items.title: Caixin: DeepSeek completes a second external funding round of about 100 billion yuan
items.summary: 財新報道，DeepSeek已完成第二輪外部融資，規模約1,000億元人民幣（報道換算約150億美元），並正準備爭取在上海科創板上市。工商變更已於11月17日完成，新投資人持股平台取得約17.3%股權；報道指公司首輪外部融資為500億元、投後估值3,500億元。
items.note: Caixin Global describes the round as about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion). Some Chinese outlets have cited investor comments of more than 105 billion yuan; this item follows Caixin's wording and does not use those higher figures.
items.imageAlt: Image accompanying Caixin's report on DeepSeek's latest funding round

items.title: Google partners with Blue Origin on the first heavy-lift Project Suncatcher launch, targeted for Q1 2029
items.summary: Google宣布同Blue Origin合作，為長期研究計劃Project Suncatcher進行首次專用重型發射，目標係2029年第一季，用New Glenn火箭把衛星送入太陽同步軌道，以利用軌道上嘅太陽能擴展人工智能基礎設施。公司稱每枚衛星大約具備一個數據中心機架嘅運算能力。
items.note: publishedAt converted from the official page meta published_time 2026-11-19T13:00:00+00:00. The page og:image is a generic Google blog image, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: MegaRobo raises nearly $200 million, with Oman Investment Authority joining the round
items.summary: 中國蘇州嘅MegaRobo宣布完成近2億美元新一輪融資，阿曼投資局加入，現有投資者Asia Investment Capital、Granite Asia同Sinovation Ventures繼續出資，中銀國際亦有參與。公司稱資金將用於核心技術、人工智能科研業務嘅全球擴張，以及讓人工智能在更複雜物理環境運作嘅基礎設施。

items.title: The Verge: New York, Los Angeles and Chicago schools consider dropping Google Search over AI features
items.summary: 《The Verge》引述《紐約時報》報道，紐約、洛杉磯同芝加哥學區正考慮尋找Google Search替代方案，因為Google表示，學區若關閉其人工智能功能，將無法繼續使用Search，有關安排將於明年起實施。Google向《The Verge》表示理解家長同教師對學生用人工智能走捷徑嘅擔憂，並稱本月開始喺Search試行Guided Learning，逐步帶領學生解題而非只給答案。
items.imageAlt: The Verge article image for the report on school districts and Google Search

items.title: TechCrunch: Citi, PNC and Citizens tell customers they are responsible for third-party AI agents
items.summary: 《TechCrunch》報道，花旗近期更新網上用戶協議，指客戶若把銀行憑證或帳戶權限交給第三方人工智能代理，即使工具外洩憑證或被黑客入侵，相關活動仍由客戶負責。報道稱PNC亦於同日更新條款，Citizens則向客戶發郵件作出類似警告；摩根大通同美國銀行上月已宣布類似政策。
items.imageAlt: Illustration of banking used in TechCrunch's report on AI-agent liability

items.title: The Verge: Nvidia says it is no longer shipping licensed Hopper data-center chips to China
items.summary: 《The Verge》報道，Nvidia臨時行政總裁Colette Kress在星期二業績電話會議表示，公司展望並未計入任何獲許可嘅Hopper數據中心產品，亦已停止向中國付運獲許可嘅Hopper數據中心產品。報道指Kress未有解釋原因，亦未說明公司往後會否繼續爭取其他對華業務。
items.note: The comment was made on Nvidia's Tuesday earnings call, which yesterday's batch covered for revenue and guidance but not this China-shipping point. The Verge article was published Nov 18, 1:01 p.m. UTC.
items.imageAlt: The Verge article image for Nvidia's China chip-shipping report

items.title: BrightAI raises $97 million led by Smith Point Capital to scale physical AI for infrastructure
items.summary: Fortune報道，BrightAI宣布獲得9,700萬美元融資，由Smith Point Capital領投，通用電氣旗下GE Vernova同其他新舊投資者參與，累計融資額達1.84億美元。公司計劃以感應器同人工智能持續監察電力、水務同管道等基礎設施，取代定期派人巡檢。
items.note: Fortune also cites a $750 million valuation according to a person familiar with the matter; that figure is not used here because it is not a confirmed company statement.
items.imageAlt: Portrait of BrightAI founder Alex Hawkinson from Fortune's report

items.title: Boltz raises a $110 million Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners
items.summary: 倫敦人工智能藥物發現公司Boltz宣布完成1.10億美元A輪融資，由Bessemer Venture Partners領投，用於加強運算、數據同擴充團隊。公司稱已同全球20大藥企當中嘅6家簽訂合作，包括輝瑞、GSK、武田同百時美施貴寶，並指自6月以來付費客戶嘅分子token用量增長50倍。
items.note: Official announcement is dated November 18th, 2026, with no exact time, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. This was not in yesterday's batch. Tech.eu covered the round on Nov 19.
items.imageAlt: Social card image from Boltz's Series A announcement

items.title: Yahoo Finance: Anthropic (ANT) closes first day at $97.17, up 17% from its $83 IPO price
items.summary: Yahoo Finance報道，Anthropic（代號ANT）11月19日喺納斯達克首日掛牌，開市價111.50美元，其後升幅收窄，收市報97.17美元，較83美元發行價升約17%。公司此次IPO籌資813億美元，Yahoo Finance稱發行時估值約1.5萬億美元；路透社報道開市後股價一度升至115美元，三大美股指數同日均跌至少2%。
items.note: This updates yesterday's pricing-only item. Close, open and IPO price are from Yahoo Finance's live report, updated Nov 19 at 6:30 p.m. EST; the $115 high and index declines are from a Reuters wrap published on Investing.com.
items.imageAlt: Yahoo Finance image from its live coverage of Anthropic's IPO debut

items.title: NVDA closes Nov 19 at $145.98 (−3.30%) as the AI trade stays under pressure
items.summary: 《Motley Fool》報道，Nvidia（NVDA）11月19日收市報145.98美元，跌3.30%；文章指雖然第三季業績同Anthropic上市早盤帶來支持，但管理層交接同人工智能開支疑慮最終佔上風。當日標普500指數跌2.02%，納斯達克綜合指數跌2.25%。
items.imageAlt: Motley Fool image from its Nov 19 stock market wrap

items.title: AMD closes Nov 19 at $489.19 (−7.72%)
items.summary: 《Motley Fool》報道，超微（AMD）11月19日收市報489.19美元，跌7.72%。路透社另述，調查媒體Hunterbrook表示其關聯基金已對AMD建立空頭倉，報道見報當日AMD跌約7.7%。
items.note: The closing price is from The Motley Fool wrap. The Hunterbrook short-position context is from a Reuters report republished by Investing.com.
items.imageAlt: Motley Fool image from its Nov 19 stock market wrap

items.title: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed is out now on Steam
items.summary: Devolver Digital 同 doinksoft 嘅橫向動作《Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed》已於 11 月 19 日登陸 Steam，平台為 PC（Windows）。GameSpot 當日已試玩並確認遊戲已經推出；Steam API 顯示發售日為 11 月 19 日，美國區原價 4.99 美元、現有 25% 折扣至 3.74 美元。
items.note: REAL UPDATE on yesterday’s “dated November 19” item. GameSpot stamp Nov 19, 2026, 12:23 PM PST = Nov 20, 04:23 HKT. Independently verified via Steam appdetails for app 4523120 (coming_soon=false, date Nov 19, 2026, Windows only, US $4.99 discounted 25% to $3.74). GameSpot og:image is a screenshot; imageUrl uses the official Steam header (HTTP 200). Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4523120/Volvys_Adventure_Reslimed/

items.title: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ is out now on Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo Life 報道，《The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+》已於 11 月 19 日登陸 Switch 2。呢個版本收錄遊戲全部 DLC，並支援最多四人線上合作。北美 eShop 週報列出美國區售價 69.99 美元。
items.note: REAL UPDATE on the previously dated Nov 19 Switch 2 / PS5 / Xbox Series listing. This Nintendo Life “GTA 6 Day” roundup treats the Switch 2 launch as out that day; the same date and US $69.99 price also appear in NL’s North America Nintendo Download for November 19 (https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2026/11/these-30plus-games-are-coming-to-nintendo-switch-eshop-this-week-november-19). Platforms follow only what this article confirms (Switch 2). Earlier announcements also dated PS5 and Xbox Series for Nov 19, but this piece does not confirm those storefronts, so they are not listed. publishedAt is approximate from NL’s “11 hours ago” stamp when fetched around 07:40 HKT on Nov 20. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d to automated checks, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is out now on Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo Life 報道，Auroch Digital 開發、Devolver Digital 發行嘅《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2》已於 11 月 19 日登陸 Switch 2。報導指遊戲上個月已登陸其他主機；Steam API 顯示 PC 版已於 10 月 14 日推出。北美 eShop 週報列出 Switch 2 美國區售價 24.99 美元。
items.note: NL says the game launched on other consoles last month and arrives on Switch 2 on Nov 19; those other consoles are not named in the article and are not listed here. PC is included because Steam appdetails for app 3115160 lists coming_soon=false and release_date Oct 14, 2026 (Windows). US $24.99 is from NL’s Nov 19 Nintendo Download. publishedAt is approximate from NL’s “11 hours ago” stamp when fetched around 07:40 HKT on Nov 20. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is the official Steam header (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2

items.title: Sumikkogurashi Welcome to Poka Poka Onsen is out now on Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo Life 報道，日本角色 IP《Sumikkogurashi Welcome to Poka Poka Onsen》已於 11 月 19 日登陸 Switch 2。遊戲由日本哥倫比亞發行，玩家要喺溫泉旅館幫忙同遊玩小遊戲；北美 eShop 週報列出美國區售價 39.99 美元。
items.note: REAL UPDATE on yesterday’s uncertain “dated November 19” item, which was not confirmed live at 07:40–07:50 HKT Nov 19. NL’s Nov 19 “GTA 6 Day” roundup treats it as launching that day; the North America Nintendo Download for November 19 lists the same date and US $39.99. Platforms follow the sources (Switch 2 only). publishedAt is approximate from NL’s “11 hours ago” stamp when fetched around 07:40 HKT on Nov 20. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Figment 1 and Figment 2 Switch 2 versions are out now
items.summary: Nintendo Life 報道，Bedtime Digital 嘅《Figment 1》同《Figment 2: Creed Valley》Switch 2 版已於 11 月 19 日推出，並稱有 60fps、1080p 同畫面強化。北美 eShop 週報列出美國區售價分別為 19.99 美元同 23.99 美元。
items.note: NL describes these as Switch 2 versions of the existing Switch games, with 60fps at 1080p and “enhanced graphics.” US prices $19.99 / $23.99 are from the Nov 19 Nintendo Download. Reader comments claim an 80% owner discount is delayed, but that is not in the article and is not treated as fact. publishedAt is approximate from NL’s “11 hours ago” stamp when fetched around 07:40 HKT on Nov 20. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves DLC character Laocorn Gaudeamus is out now
items.summary: SNK 宣布，《FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves》Season 3 第六位 DLC 角色 Laocorn Gaudeamus 已於 11 月 19 日推出，並附專屬 Arcade Mode 同 Episodes of South Town 劇情。遊戲平台包括 PS5、PS4、Xbox Series、Steam、Epic Games Store 同 Switch 2；Season Pass 3 售價 19.99 美元，Revenge Edition 為 49.99 美元（Switch 2 版 29.99 美元）。
items.note: REAL UPDATE on the previously dated Nov 19 DLC listing. SNK official press is calendar-dated 2026.11.19 with no clock time, so publishedAt is midnight HKT. Platforms follow the supported-platform list in the same release (Steam, Epic Games Store, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2). A 75% off Legend Edition offer is mentioned, but SNK says sale dates vary by storefront, so it is not treated as a confirmed live price. The SNK page og:image is a generic 2024 site image, so imageUrl is the official Steam header for the base game (app 2492040, HTTP 200). Corroborated by GoNintendo’s Nov 19 “today” write-up.
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves

items.title: Blacksmith Master leaves Early Access and is out now at version 1.0
items.summary: Hooded Horse 同 Untitled Studio 宣布，中世紀鍛造管理遊戲《Blacksmith Master》已結束搶先體驗，1.0 正式版登陸 PC，經 Steam、GOG、Epic Games Store 同 Microsoft Store 發售。Steam API 確認發售日為 11 月 19 日，支援 Windows、macOS 同 Linux，美國區原價 19.99 美元，推出頭兩星期有 50% 折扣至 9.99 美元。
items.note: This is a 1.0 / leave-Early-Access launch, not a repeat of the May 15, 2025 Early Access date that caused yesterday’s Thai roundup to be dismissed. Games Press date is calendar-only (19/11/2026), so publishedAt is midnight HKT. Independently verified via Steam appdetails for app 2292800 (coming_soon=false, date Nov 19, 2026, Windows/Mac/Linux, US $19.99 discounted 50% to $9.99). Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292800/Blacksmith_Master/
items.imageAlt: Key art for Blacksmith Master

items.title: Flame, Forest & Flood is out now in Steam Early Access
items.summary: Fairy Mount Games（創辦人曾參與《Ori and the Will of the Wisps》同《No Rest for the Wicked》）嘅輕鬆策略《Flame, Forest & Flood》已於 11 月 19 日登陸 Steam 搶先體驗，平台為 PC（Windows 同 Linux），美國區售價 14.99 美元。遊戲支援 1 至 3 人，可單機、本地或線上對戰，對局之間可打理花園。
items.note: Games Press page is dated 11/19/2026 (the body also carries an 18 November dateline announcing a Nov 19 launch), so publishedAt is midnight HKT. Independently verified via Steam appdetails for app 3096460 (coming_soon=false, date Nov 19, 2026, Windows and Linux, US $14.99 with no discount). The Ori / No Rest for the Wicked credit is from the same Games Press release. The fetch did not return a usable Games Press og:image, so imageUrl is the official Steam header (HTTP 200). Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096460/Flame_Forest__Flood/
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Flame, Forest & Flood

items.title: Crusader Kings III is free to play on Steam until November 23, and 70% off until November 30
items.summary: Polygon 報道，《Crusader Kings III》正喺 Steam 舉行免費週末，直至 11 月 23 日（星期一）上午 10 時（太平洋時間）。期間遊戲亦有 70% 折扣，美國區由 49.99 美元減至 14.99 美元，折扣至 11 月 30 日。呢次活動緊接 11 月 17 日推出嘅 Silk & Silver 資料片同免費 1.21 Florin 更新。
items.note: Polygon stamp Nov 19, 2026, 4:19 PM EST = Nov 20, 05:19 HKT. The Silk & Silver / 1.21 Florin launch was already in the Nov 18 official batch; this item is the new free-weekend and sale offer, not a repeat of that launch. imageUrl is the article og:image (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Crusader Kings III promotional art

items.title: Valve is selling the 512GB Steam Machine without a waitlist, while supplies last
items.summary: The Verge 報道，Valve 已開放 512GB Steam Machine 直接加入購物車購買，售完會顯示缺貨而非再開等候名單。2TB 型號已向所有預約者發出購買邀請，但因等候人數多過現有產量而關閉新登記；Valve 指記憶體同儲存成本持續急升，尚未確定之後可以生產幾多部、以甚麼價錢出售，並預計 1 月再公布供應消息。The Verge 撰稿時見到 512GB 預計 3 至 5 個工作日送達，不連手把售價 1,049 美元、2TB 為 1,349 美元。
items.note: The Verge stamp Nov 19, 2026, 7:33 PM UTC = Nov 20, 03:33 HKT. Do not write that Valve has confirmed a price hike; the company said it does not yet know future production volume or price. $1,049 / $1,349 are the launch prices restated by The Verge; the 3-to-5-business-day delivery estimate is what The Verge saw at the time of writing. Corroborated by GamingOnLinux (19 Nov 2026, 8:11 pm UTC) and IGN. imageUrl is the article og:image (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: A Steam Machine photographed by The Verge

items.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam Switch 2 and Switch digital pre-orders are up, still dated December 10
items.summary: LEVEL-5 宣布，《雷頓教授與蒸汽的新世界》Switch 2 同 Switch 數位預購已經開放，售價 64.99 美元／53.99 英鎊／64.99 歐元／7,920 日圓，預購附送系列原聲精選。Gematsu 指遊戲將於 12 月 10 日登陸 PS5、Switch 2、Switch 同 Steam（PC）；PS5 同 PC 預購已於上週開始。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 19, 2026, 10:12 AM EST = Nov 19, 23:12 HKT. The December 10 date is presented as previously announced; the new fact is Switch 2 / Switch digital pre-orders plus new story and gameplay details. Steam appdetails for app 3384600 lists coming_soon=true and date “Dec 9, 2026,” which may be a timezone split versus Gematsu’s December 10 and is not treated as a delay. Gematsu hero 403’d, so imageUrl is the official Steam header (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Professor Layton and the New World of Steam

items.title: Steam Frame Standalone Verified games pass 300, with 312 listed at press time
items.summary: GamingOnLinux 報道，Steam Frame 嘅 Standalone Verified 遊戲已超過 300 款，撰稿時 SteamDB 數字為 312 款 Verified、97 款 Playable、209 款 Unsupported。按標籤計，其中約 101 款為 VR 遊戲，其餘為可喺 Frame 以劇院模式遊玩嘅平面遊戲。
items.note: GOL timestamp 19 Nov 2026 at 2:45 pm UTC (updated 2:56 pm UTC) = Nov 19, 22:45 HKT. The 312 / 97 / 209 and “101 VR-tagged” figures are as reported by GOL citing SteamDB at the time of writing and were not independently re-counted. imageUrl is the article og:image (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: A Steam Frame headset on a desk

items.title: Famitsu: Ocarina of Time remake adds 86,097 Japanese retail copies as Pikmin 4 Switch 2 debuts at 2,854
items.summary: Famitsu 公布日本 11 月 9 日至 15 日實體軟件銷量，《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》Switch 2 版以再售 86,097 套繼續居首，累計 623,138 套。《Metaphor: ReFantazio》Switch 2 版首週 11,167 套排第二；《Pikmin 4》Switch 2 版 + Dandori Academy 首週 2,854 套排第八。同期 Switch 2 硬件售出 42,402 部，系列累計 6,616,858 部。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 19, 2026, 8:11 AM EST = Nov 19, 21:11 HKT. All figures are Famitsu estimates as reported by Gematsu. Rankings 11 to 30 are scheduled to be published November 20 and are not included. Nintendo Life also covered the Japanese charts the same day. Gematsu hero 403’d and no clear alternative official image was used, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter version 1.08 adds a Switch 2 30fps lock in graphics mode
items.summary: Nintendo Life 引述官方更新說明，《Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter》Switch／Switch 2 版已更新至 1.08（11 月 19 日），喺繪圖／效能設定加入可將繪圖模式鎖定 30fps 嘅選項（僅限 Switch 2），並修復戰鬥卡關、崩潰同 SSR 設定等問題。《2nd Chapter》已於 11 月 12 日以 1.05 加入同一項 Switch 2 功能。
items.note: NL displays a 6:55am clock time on this article. Treated as UK GMT on Nov 19 (the article sits in the Nov 2026 news section and was not in yesterday’s batch) = Nov 19, 14:55 HKT. The 1.08 patch date (19 November 2026) and the 1.05 / 12 November 2026 notes for 2nd Chapter are quoted from the official patch notes in the article. The 30fps lock is explicitly Switch 2 only. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: The US Nintendo eShop Black Friday sale is live through December 2
items.summary: NintendoEverything 報道，美國 Nintendo eShop 2026 年 Black Friday 遊戲折扣已於 11 月 19 日開始，涵蓋 Switch 2 同 Switch 作品。Nintendo 早前公布美國數位折扣期為 11 月 19 日至 12 月 2 日晚上 11:59（太平洋時間）；該報導指《Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition》同《Kirby and the Forgotten Land》嘅 Switch 2 版現為 48.99 美元同 55.99 美元（原價分別 69.99 同 79.99 美元）。
items.note: This is the “sale is live” recap that was not in yesterday’s batch. NintendoEverything is dated November 19, 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt is midnight HKT. The official US window (Nov 19 through Dec 2, 11:59 p.m. PT) was previously announced on Nintendo’s Nov 12 post: https://www.nintendo.com/us/whatsnew/nintendo-announces-black-friday-offers-to-help-spread-joy-this-holiday-season/ . Example US prices in the summary are from NintendoEverything’s list, which also calls those two Switch 2 editions their lowest prices yet; that “lowest ever” claim is not independently re-checked. Official Nintendo UK highlights dated 19/11/2026 separately say the Black Friday Sale “has begun” in that region until November 29, which overlaps the already-live EU sale noted in yesterday’s research and should not be mixed with the US end date. imageUrl is the article og:image (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Promotional art for the 2026 Nintendo eShop Black Friday sale on Switch 2 and Switch

items.title: Some PS5 players report crashing out of GTA 6 with error CE-108255-1
items.summary: GamesRadar 報道，部分 PS5《GTA 6》玩家喺開場過場或故事前期反覆遇到錯誤代碼 CE-108255-1 並當機，標準版同 Slim 都有報告。Rockstar 支援頁只引導至平台官方說明，Sony 建議先更新遊戲，但報道當時未見有新嘅遊戲更新；文章同時強調呢啲係玩家回報，尚未證實屬大規模問題。
items.note: uncertain=true because the story is based on player/Reddit reports; GamesRadar says it found more than a dozen similar posts but cautions this may not be widespread, and there was no Rockstar or Sony confirmation of a game-wide defect. publishedAt converted from article:published_time 2026-11-19T21:35:04Z. The article headline and Sony heading use CE-108255-1; the body sometimes typoes it as CE-108225-1. No day-one patch was reported at the time of the article.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI artwork used to illustrate a report on PS5 crash errors

items.title: Japan's GTA 6 release censors nudity and tones down blood and gore
items.summary: VGC 報道，日本版《GTA 6》大幅限制裸露同血腥表現，Jason 同 Lucia 沖涼時會着泳裝，其他地區則為裸體；血腥同肢解程度被調低，而且唔可以好似其他地區咁喺設定入面調高。報道引述 GameSpark 整理，指傷者同死者出血被淡化，斬首畫面被移除，但玩法暴力程度據報同國際版一樣。
items.note: publishedAt converted from VGC dateline 19th Nov 2026 / 4:32 pm, treated as UK GMT. Decapitation and blood details are attributed to GameSpark as cited by VGC. VGC og:image 403'd from the research box, so imageUrl is null. Kotaku and Push Square also covered the same launch-day finding.

items.title: Digital Foundry says GTA 6 holds a steadier 30fps on PS5 Pro than on base PS5
items.summary: Push Square 引述 Digital Foundry 測試，指《GTA 6》喺 PS5 Pro 以 30fps 運行時表現「非常穩陣」、幀間隔近乎完美，並受惠於 PSSR，畫面清晰度明顯高過標準版 PS5。標準版 PS5 日常遊玩大致能維持 30fps，但高速駕駛會出現輕微掉幀，激烈戰鬥同爆炸更可能出現較持續嘅下降，幀率可跌至 20 多幀中段。
items.note: Launch-day tech verdict, distinct from yesterday's pre-launch 'PS5 Pro cannot do 60fps' quote. publishedAt converted from Push Square dateline 'Yesterday, 4pm' as captured on the morning of 20 Nov 2026 HKT, treated as 19 Nov 2026 16:00 GMT. Original analysis is Digital Foundry; The Verge also summarised DF earlier at 2026-11-18T20:12:00Z (https://www.theverge.com/games/1037018/gta-vi-framerate-resolution-compared-playstation-xbox), which was before yesterday's batch cutoff, so this later Push Square write-up is the preferred source. Push Square og:image 403'd from the research box, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Xbox Free Play Days add Deadlink, Slayers X and Polterguys from November 19 to 22
items.summary: Xbox Wire 宣布，11 月 19 日至 22 日，《Deadlink》、《Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer》同《Polterguys: Possession Party》納入 Free Play Days，Game Pass Ultimate、Premium 同 Essential 會員可喺 Xbox One 及 Xbox Series 免費試玩。官方並指活動期間部分版本有限時折扣，實際優惠視地區而定。
items.note: publishedAt converted from article:published_time 2026-11-19T16:00:00+00:00. The unusual spelling 'Vengance' is as used in the official Xbox Wire headline. An editor's note says Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor is not in this week's Free Play Days.
items.imageAlt: Xbox Free Play Days artwork for the November 19 to 22 weekend lineup

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is now available on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: Take-Two 及 Rockstar 宣布，《Grand Theft Auto VI》已登陸 PS5 同 Xbox Series X|S，可喺 PlayStation Store、Microsoft Store、Rockstar Games Store 及全球零售購買。Rockstar 創辦人 Sam Houser 發表上市聲明，官方並稱遊戲以史上最高評分之姿推出；同步發行由 Atlantic Records 推出、收錄 34 首原創歌曲嘅《Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album》。
items.note: Official Business Wire / Take-Two IR launch announcement, datelined NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026; exact timestamp was not on the IR page, so publishedAt is date-only at T00:00:00+08:00. Xbox Wire also published an official out-now post at 2026-11-19T14:00:00+00:00 (https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/11/19/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-out-now/). The 'highest rated game of all time' wording is Rockstar/Take-Two's launch claim, not a new independently audited Metacritic recount. imageUrl is the IR page og:image with empty query parameters removed; the same asset returned HTTP 200.
items.imageAlt: Official Grand Theft Auto VI key art featuring Lucia and Jason

items.title: Sony cancels preorders for Pulse Elevate speakers and FlexStrike fight stick after delays
items.summary: PlayStation Lifestyle 報道，Sony 正在取消 Pulse Elevate 無線桌面喇叭同 FlexStrike 街機搖桿嘅現有預購，兩款配件已無限期延期。Sony 聲明指 Pulse Elevate 喺品質測試中發現生產問題，FlexStrike 則歸因於「預期之外嘅生產延誤」，並向預購玩家致歉。
items.note: publishedAt is date-only at T00:00:00+08:00 because the article is dated November 19, 2026 with no exact timestamp. Mid-tier outlet, but it quotes a Sony quality-testing statement and cancellation emails. This is not the Pulse wireless headset, which was separately scheduled to go on sale November 19; no equally strong official 'out now' post was found for the headset, so that scheduled launch was not given its own item.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Pulse Elevate wireless desktop speakers

items.title: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs at its Montréal and Québec City studios
items.summary: CBC 引述 Ubisoft 公關向 Radio-Canada 確認，公司喺蒙特利爾同魁北克城裁減 166 個職位，其中蒙特利爾 128 個、魁北克城 38 個，少於其加拿大總員工嘅 4%。公司指生產需求轉變，受影響嘅主要係製作團隊及部分支援人員，並會提供遣散費同轉職支援。
items.note: publishedAt converted from CBC byline Nov 19, 2026 2:04 PM EST. The 128/38 split comes from Ubisoft PR Antoine Leduc-Labelle, as reported by CBC/Radio-Canada. VGC also reported the 166 total (https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/ubisoft-is-laying-off-166-staff-in-its-montreal-and-quebec-city-offices/) but did not have the city split. Platforms omitted because CBC does not name current titles or platforms in this report.
items.imageAlt: The Ubisoft building in Quebec City

items.title: GTA 6 becomes the most-watched game ever on Twitch and Kick in its first day
items.summary: IGN 引述 Streamlabs 同 Streams Charts 數據，指《GTA 6》全球上市約 26 小時內已成為 Twitch 同 Kick 有史以來最受歡迎嘅遊戲。Streamlabs 統計觀看時數超過 1.18 億小時，Streams Charts 則指喺 Kick、YouTube 同 Twitch 合計超過 1.25 億小時；兩間機構嘅數字並不完全一致。
items.note: REAL UPDATE versus yesterday's preliminary 7.89 million concurrent-viewer peak. This item leads on the first-day hours-watched totals and the Twitch/Kick 'most popular ever' claim, not a recycled peak-viewer figure. uncertain=true because Streamlabs (118 million hours; IGN also cites a 7.25 million peak) and Streams Charts (more than 125 million hours) do not fully agree, and totals were still moving. publishedAt converted from article:published_time 2026-11-19T18:51:11.012Z. Variety separately reported a DE-CIX global traffic peak of 33.03 Tbit/s on the evening of 18 Nov (https://variety.com/2026/gaming/news/gta-6-launch-livestream-internet-traffic-records-1236953145/), but that traffic peak itself occurred before yesterday's batch cutoff.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI review still used to illustrate IGN's livestream-record report

items.title: Ubisoft H1 net bookings fall 16.5% as it establishes Motherbrain, a generative AI subsidiary
items.summary: Ubisoft 公布 2026-27 財年上半年淨預訂額為 6.447 億歐元，按年下跌 16.5%；第二季為 3.89 億歐元，高於約 3.70 億歐元指引，主要受《Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced》帶動。公司同時宣布成立專注「玩法創新人工智能」嘅附屬公司 Motherbrain，並指新營運模式已全面到位。
items.note: publishedAt converted from GlobeNewswire 'November 19, 2026 11:45 ET', treated as US Eastern Standard Time. Official release also says the H1 fixed cost base was €660m, down 6% year-on-year, and headcount was down close to 1,100 over the semester; FY guidance was confirmed. VGC separately reported the Motherbrain confirmation (https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/ubisoft-has-founded-a-studio-dedicated-to-generative-ai-in-games/). Platforms reflect the release's statement that Rainbow Six Siege ranked in the top 10 MAU across Xbox and PlayStation combined in H1. The GlobeNewswire og:image was only about 10KB and appeared to be a logo, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 at about 19.05 million units and $1.84 billion as of launch morning
items.summary: GamesBeat 引述 Sensor Tower 估計，《GTA 6》截至上市日已錄得約 1,905 萬套、收入約 18.4 億美元，當中約 75%（約 1,423 萬套／13.8 億美元）喺 PlayStation，約 25%（約 482 萬套／4.64 億美元）喺 Xbox。呢啲係第三方估計，並非 Take-Two 官方首日銷量；路透社同樣引述該機構，將數字寫成截至周四早上約 1,910 萬套。
items.note: REAL UPDATE versus yesterday's Sensor Tower pre-order estimate of 17.07 million units / about $1.65 billion. Figures must stay labelled as a third-party estimate, not official launch-day sales; Take-Two has not published a figure. GamesBeat frames the 19.05 million as preorders 'before today's launch' and $1.84 billion 'sold at launch'. Reuters, as reprinted by CNA (https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/take-two-set-shatter-sales-records-gta-vi-launches-massive-fanfare-6566746), says Sensor Tower estimated 19.1 million units and about $1.84 billion 'as of Thursday morning'. publishedAt converted from article:published_time 2026-11-19T15:34:00+00:00.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI promotional artwork used in GamesBeat's Sensor Tower report

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 was October's US best-seller but is absent from Circana's 2026 year-to-date top 10
items.summary: Push Square 引述 Circana 分析員 Mat Piscatella，指《Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4》係 2026 年 10 月美國最暢銷遊戲，連續第 19 年有 Call of Duty 作品成為其上市月份冠軍，但截至目前仍未進入 2026 年全年迄今十大。全年迄今十大由《NBA 2K27》領跑，名單內唯一 Call of Duty 作品係《Black Ops 2》移植版，排第 6。
items.note: publishedAt converted from the Circana/Mat Piscatella thread timestamp quoted in the article (2026-11-19T14:00:26.053Z). Push Square's own exact timestamp was not in the metadata; the story was on the site later the same day ('8 hours ago' on the morning of 20 Nov 2026 HKT). Platforms are taken from Push Square's game footer for Modern Warfare 4. October top 10 and YTD top 10 lists are in the article if a fuller chart item is wanted. items.title: 007 First Light wins Game of the Year at the 2026 TIGA Awards
items.summary: 英國遊戲協會 TIGA 公布 2026 年頒獎結果，由典禮現場投票選出嘅年度遊戲由 IO Interactive 嘅《007 First Light》奪得。Dovetail Games 獲得包括最佳發行商在內嘅四個獎項，Playground Games 獲最佳大型工作室，SFB Games 嘅《The Mermaid Mask》則獲最佳敘事等獎項；典禮於 11 月 18 日喺倫敦舉行。
items.note: publishedAt converted from article:published_time 2026-11-19T07:18:50+00:00. The ceremony itself was on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at Plaisterers' Hall, London. Platforms omitted because the official winners post does not list platforms for the winning titles.
items.imageAlt: Attendees at the TIGA Games Industry Awards 2026 ceremony in London

items.title: Embark Studios apologizes after replacing The Finals esports casters with AI voices
items.summary: PC Gamer 報道，Embark Studios 已刪除《The Finals》亞太區閉門資格賽精華片，因為片中用遊戲內 AI 解說員 Scotty 同 June 取代咗原場人類解說嘅聲音。社區及競技營運主管 Oscar Lundberg 承認做法係「錯誤」，並指原定以同樣形式推出嘅美洲同歐非中東精華亦不會如期推出。
items.note: In the 48-hour window but published before yesterday's official batch cutoff; not in the skip list, so included as a missed industry item. publishedAt converted from article:published_time 2026-11-18T19:10:43Z. Platforms omitted because the article does not restate The Finals' release platforms.
